text:
maria (sec-eng): heads up — CI failing on `audit-validator` after the RBAC change pushed this morning. golden fixtures mismatch on actor/kms fields. anyone free to look?

arjun (platform): saw the pipeline, repros locally for me. failing assertion: `expected actor.id to be string, got object`

ci-bot: Pipeline #4321 — audit-validator — FAILED (tests: 4 failed, 112 passed) › https://ci.company/4321

sam (infra): do we have a change in the KMS envelope shape? I remember the RBAC patch wrapped actor metadata in `principal` sometimes.

maria (sec-eng): yes the RBAC PR (refs #789) moved actor -> { principal: { id, type }, roles: [...] } for some event types. but audit schema still expects `actor.id` at top-level.

toni (sre): quick workaround: add a compatibility shim in validator that looks for `actor.principal.id` if `actor.id` missing, return a soft-warning metric. we should still fix golden fixtures tho.

arjun (platform): I'm hesitant to add heuristics in validator w/o flag. This is customer-facing audit events — we need deterministic validation. Suggest: 1) bump schema version 2) provide migrator to transform incoming events for older consumers 3) update goldens and CI to run both schema versions.

maria (sec-eng): agreed on schema bump. impact matrix: internal infra (Dedicated) already uses new shape; hosted API still emits old shape for backwards compat. failing tests are the golden-set that expects old shape.

sam (infra): repro steps I used: `git checkout origin/main && docker-compose run validator pytest tests/golden/*.py::test_event_shape -k kms` — gives stack trace.

maria (sec-eng): stack excerpt: ```
AssertionError: actor.id not found
Expected: string
Actual: {"principal": {"id": "svc-123", "type": "service"}, "roles": ["read"]}
```

arjun (platform): quick patch to CI to mute the failing test while we coordinate? or add golden update PR with schema v2 goldens.

toni (sre): don't mute without compensating alert. If we mute, add a short-lived alert rule: `audit-validator.goldens.failures > 0` -> on-call.

maria (sec-eng): I opened a bug: SEC-1123 with notes and linked RBAC PR. I'm going to push a PR that adds schema v2 and a migration helper used by validator's ingest path. will also update goldens. assigning to @arjun for review.

arjun (platform): on it. I'll also add a CI matrix job `goldens: schema_v1` and `goldens: schema_v2` so we don't regress both ways.

sam (infra): we should check KMS envelope parity too — looks like envelope `envelope.kms.ref` changed from `key_id` -> `reference`. customers parsing `key_id` will break. adding `kms.compat` shim in ingest path seems wise.

maria (sec-eng): good catch. include a tiny transform: if `envelope.kms.reference` exists and `key_id` missing, copy reference -> key_id. We'll log a compat metric.

toni (sre): action items summary: 
- maria: PR for schema v2 + migration helper + goldens update (SEC-1123)
- arjun: review + add CI matrix jobs
- sam: add KMS compat transform in ingest codepath and run perf check
- toni: add alert when goldens fail if we temporarily mute tests

arjun (platform): I pushed initial CI matrix change: https://ci.company/configs/patch/109 — it will run both suites. waiting on maria's golden PR to land.

maria (sec-eng): PR: https://git.company/sec/audit-validator/pull/556 — includes goldens and schema v2. added migration helper with tests. pls review.

sam (infra): ran the PR branch in staging, validator ingest latency +2ms median with compat shims — acceptable.

toni (sre): scheduling a quick 15m sync at 09:30 to sign off on deployment plan. @arjun @maria @sam please join.

maria (sec-eng): thanks all — goal is to land goldens + CI matrix today, then cut a canary release to hosted for 1h and monitor `audit.events.invalid_rate`.

arjun (platform): noted. I'll add the canary rollback policy to the deploy job: if `invalid_rate > 0.5%` for 5m, automatic rollback.

ci-bot: Reminder: new pipeline runs triggered by PRs will be queued.

maria (sec-eng): closing the thread here, will @mention once PR reviews done. :thumbsup:
